one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-30. Revised: the China export-control suspension was extended at the 24-25 Sep Trump-Xi visit to 10 Jan 2027, so no policy cliff falls in the window. Q3 2026 results are most likely ~Nov 5: there is no 8-K or company date announcement, MP reported Q3 on Nov 2-7 in every year 2021-2025, and TipRanks' 'Oct 29' has no company source; I now put ~10% (was ~50%) on the print landing inside the window, so I no longer widen for earnings. With no scheduled catalyst I use a near-symmetric lognormal centred at ~$47 (spot $47.29, Oct 1 trade ~$46.7) with monthly sigma 0.20 (74% annual / 3.5 ~0.21, slightly trimmed now that earnings are out of the window). Headline risk from China news and 23% short interest keeps tails fat on both sides, with no directional edge.

fair_value.method: 70/30 blend of EV/EBITDA (NTM EBITDA at Sep-2027 ~$430M x 20x = $8.6B EV + ~$1.25B net cash and claims, over ~239M fully diluted shares = $41.2) and forward P/E (NTM EPS ~$0.92 x 45x = $41.4).

inputs_detail.derivation: Time-weighted NTM consensus at Sep-2027 = 0.25 x $377.7M + 0.75 x $540M = ~$500M; haircut ~15% because Q2 2026 adj. EBITDA was only $28.5M (~$114M annualized, 62% of it PPA income) and MP's 2021-24 history shows ramp slippage.

Today's EV on a corrected ~239M FD basis is ~$9.8B, ~18x 2028 consensus; Lynas trades ~46x trailing on depressed earnings. I use 20x forward (down from 22x in round 1, which was applied to an overstated base and share count) for the DoW-backed strategic premium, above commodity-miner 8-10x.

Jun 30 2026 cash+ST investments $1,452.6M less non-convert debt (~$187M = $934.6M total less $747.5M 2030 notes) = ~$1.27B; less ~$0.65B burn on 10X/Independence capex to Sep-2027 (consensus net cash falls from $355M end-2026 to $173M end-2027 on a converts-as-debt basis) = ~$0.6B; plus $336M warrant exercise cash (11.2M at $30.03) and ~$320M capped-call value (34.4M shares x $21.74-31.06 spread).

178.1M basic (31 Jul 2026) + 34.4M from 2030 converts ($747.5M at ~$21.74) + 13.3M DoW Series A preferred + 11.2M DoW warrant (both $30.03) + ~2.3M RSU/PSU, per Q2 10-Q as summarised in the supervisor fact-check.
0.25 x $0.83 + 0.75 x $1.12 = ~$1.05, haircut ~12% for ramp risk and the wide spread of 2027 estimates ($0.68 MarketBeat to $0.87 StockAnalysis).
Lynas ~63x trailing near its 2-year low; cut to 45x (from 50x) as earnings normalize; weight cut to 30% because the supervisor rightly flagged this method as fragile given the EPS spread.

bear.story: The 10 Jan 2027 truce decision becomes a durable deal or a further rollover, Chinese NdPr stays below the $110 floor, market stops paying a scarcity premium; GM/Independence magnet ramp or 10X slips, 2027 EBITDA falls well short of the $378M consensus and bill-and-hold/PPA-heavy earnings get punished. Stock trades toward contracted/floor value (~$22-28/share on 239M FD shares), echoing the 2022-24 -75% post-boom unwind.

base.story: Managed tension: suspension rolled over in January without a full deal; NdPr 1,000-1,300 t/q, floor and PPA keep Materials profitable, Independence magnets ship to GM, 2027 EBITDA ~$300-380M and the market prices ~$430-500M NTM at ~18-20x. Stock stays in the $38-60 range it has held for most of 2026.

bull.story: The January cliff lapses or China re-escalates (new controls/blacklists as in Jun-Jul 2026), the DoD's 1 Jan 2027 ban on China-origin magnets in defense supply chains takes hold, NdPr back above $110, heavy-RE separation and magnet contracts re-rate MP as the sole scaled US mine-to-magnet platform; revisits the 2025-26 $70-100 spike range, amplified by 23% short interest.

thesis_break_reason: ~$30 is the DoW preferred/warrant price and, on ~239M FD shares, a ~$7.2B equity value that roughly equals floor-protected Materials (~$130-200M/yr EBITDA), the net value of the 10X EBITDA guarantee (~$3-4/share) and net cash, with nothing for Independence magnets or heavy rare earths. Trading there would most likely mean a failed magnet qualification, a 10X funding gap/equity raise or a change in DoW support, not ordinary 74%-vol noise. Kept at $30; the supervisor's fact-check supports it.

reasoning: Base-rate lane, round 2. (1) MP's own history (Twelve Data monthly closes Jun 2020-Sep 2026) is unchanged: ~73% realized vol; across 63 rolling 12-month windows median +4%, 10th pct -47%, 25th -29%, 75th +104%, 90th +205%; fat right tail from policy spikes, left tail from the 2022-24 unwind. The current setup still resembles post-spike consolidation (-53% from the Oct 2025 high, $38-66 range in 2026). (2) Supervisor corrections I accept: FD shares ~239M with converts as equity (I had 203M while subtracting the converts as debt, overstating per-share value ~$2); 2027 EBITDA consensus is now $377.7M (re-verified on MarketScreener 2026-10-01; 2028 $540M, 2027 EPS $0.83, 2028 $1.12), not $451.5M; truce cliff is 10 Jan 2027, not late November (Manifold also shows 97% that an extension past Nov 10 is announced, consistent); Q3 results most likely ~Nov 5, outside the window. (3) New in-lane evidence: no Polymarket/Kalshi market on the January cliff exists (gamma API search), Manifold heavy-RE licensing lift by end-2026 still ~9%; the DoD 1 Jan 2027 ban on China-origin magnets in defense supply chains is a dated demand catalyst. The modal path remains managed tension. (4) Valuation: EV/EBITDA $41.2 (NTM ~$430M x 20x + ~$1.25B claims / 239M) and P/E $41.4 (0.92 x 45x), blended $41.3, about $6 below spot and below the supervisor's ~$44 because I use a 20x multiple on a ~15% haircut base and a heavier capex burn; sell-side mean ~$74 treated as stale. (5) Ladder: mixture of a lognormal centred at $44.5 (sigma 0.62, 80%) and a wider $50-centred component (sigma 0.95, 20%) to reproduce MP's right skew and the January binary; centre is between fair value ($41) and spot ($47) because fair-value error at 74% vol is large and history shows a positive median drift; lower tail trimmed slightly for the floor, $1.45B cash and DoW backing. Median ~$45.5, mean ~$51. Research in round 2 was limited to ~4 queries.
